fullData.title: Guess and Measure with Bears!
fullData.description: Practice estimating how many cute little bears will fit along everyday objects before laying them out to count!

challenges.instruction: Take a look at the spoon. How many bears do you think will fit along its length? Make your best guess!
challenges.hint: Look at the length of the spoon and compare it to the size of a single bear to make your guess.
challenges.narration: Let's check out this spoon! How many bears do you think will fit along it? Give it your best guess!

challenges.instruction: Here is a straw. Before we place any bears, how many do you guess it will take to measure it?
challenges.hint: Count how long the straw looks, and think about how many bears can line up end-to-end.
challenges.narration: Now we have a straw! Take a close look and make your guess before we start tiling our bears.

challenges.instruction: Check out this toothbrush! Make a fun guess about how many bears will stretch from one end to the other.
challenges.hint: This one is a bit longer! Think about how many bears you might need for a longer object.
challenges.narration: It's time for our final challenge with the toothbrush. Make your guess before we lay down the bears!
